title: E-Paper Desk Calendar

hardware.candidate: ESP32-C3 SuperMini candidate with 2.9-inch SPI e-paper; controller revision unresolved

supplementaryRequirements: Exact e-paper controller, flex connector and refresh behavior must be identified. Upstream FreeCAD case is not proven to fit the proposed 2.9-inch panel.

tests.name: Photograph panel/FPC and read controller part number
tests.acceptance: Controller ID and LUT/driver compatibility established

tests.name: Render checkerboard and full-black/white pages
tests.procedure: Capture images after full refresh and inspect ghosting
tests.acceptance: No stuck pixel region or ghosting beyond documented panel limit

tests.name: Set timezone and sync UTC from network
tests.procedure: Test near a local day boundary
tests.acceptance: Correct calendar date and daylight-saving behavior

tests.name: Remove Wi-Fi and restart
tests.acceptance: Time validity clearly indicated rather than made up

tests.name: Measure sleep current and safe refresh cadence
tests.acceptance: Measurable current, no excessive repeated full refresh
